text:
Alex G: Quick heads-up 1: ACME wants a single-page upgrade commitment for private deploys (VPC + on-prem) covering egress IP preservation, rollback windows, and KMS options.
Mira L: Got it. Do they need static egress IPs preserved across upgrades or just during runtime?
Alex G: They want preservation across upgrades5 definitely called out as a must.
Samir: Recommend we present two supported shipping lanes:
- operator-relay (fast onramp, relay egress, minimal NetOps)
- tenant-vpc (dedicated egress, IPAM handoff, required for regulated customers)
Joel: For operator-relay we can offer N-1 patch compatibility guarantee and an automated rollback if egress changes. For tenant-vpc we must do staged rolling upgrades with IP-preservation smoke tests before cutover.
Mira L: Proposal for rollout template: "canary 1% for 2h, ramp 10% for 6h, full 24h" with clear rollback triggers: error rate > 2x baseline, p95 latency +50%, or egress.ip drift.
Samir: Call out airgap/offline upgrade path: acceptable maintenance window 234 hours, preflight DB migration checks required, operator-shim >= 0.9.
Alex G: ACME also asked about HashiCorp Vault for KMS. We currently support AWS/GCP KMS. Short-term we can document Vault as customer-managed via env secrets and rotation script; mid-term queue native Vault integration.
Joel: Add legal/contract note: IP handoff requires customer-provided CIDR + peering/BGP and they must sign network ownership disclaimer. For enterprise customers we can commit 6h escalated resolution SLA if we cause IP drift.
Mira L: I'll draft the one-pager + values.yaml snippets and preflight checklist. Sample snippet below for operator lane:
```
# values.yaml (operator-relay lane)
network:
  mode: operator-relay
  egress:
    preserve_ips: false
    relay_endpoint: "relay.acme.example:443"
upgradePolicy:
  canaryPercent: 1
  canaryDuration: 2h
  rampTo: 10
  rampDuration: 6h
  fullRolloutAfter: 24h
  rollbackTriggers:
    - errorRateMultiplier: 2
    - p95LatencyIncreasePct: 50
    - egressIpChange: true
```
Samir: Also include tenant-vpc alt: set egress.preserve_ips: true, note IPAM handoff steps and NetOps checklist.
Alex G: What rollback window can we commit to if egress IP moves during upgrade? ACME expects immediate rollback and a human-resolve SLA for enterprise customers.
Joel: We can promise immediate automated rollback and a 6h incident resolution SLA for enterprise plans. Self-serve customers get automated rollback without guaranteed human SLA.
Mira L: Action items: 1) one-pager on lanes + explicit upgrade SLAs (Mira) 2) sample values + preflight checklist (Mira) 3) Vault-as-KMS short-term doc (Samir) 4) legal IP handoff blurb (Alex) 5) add rollout templates to Console checklist + dashboard knobs (Joel).
Samir: ops-bot, please open a canary-run ticket and attach the playbook when ready.
ops-bot: Created ticket #CAN-2301 scheduled canary 1% next Thu 08:00 UTC.
Alex G: Great. Mira aim for EOD tomorrow on the one-pager so I can share with ACME before Friday's call. :thumbsup:
